items.anchor: 但 GQA、MoE、不均匀 layer、multimodal encoder 或特殊 position/attention 会改变 divisibility 与 partition。框架必须从 model config 建立真实 layout，不能只按参数量平均。
items.placement: immediately after the exact anchor and before ‘3D Parallelism’
items.proposed_delta: 规则模型可在 device forward 内临时推导 shape/layout metadata；多模态 variable-length/window attention 若调用 grid_thw.tolist、max.cpu 等 D2H 操作，会把 host synchronization 藏进 GPU critical path。可选分支让 dataloader/collator 按 model-config revision 预计算 cu_seqlens/window_index/max-seqlen，以 versioned metadata 交给 ViT forward；runtime fallback 仍保留，启用优化前以同输入 exact-logit gate 证明 producer/consumer 一致。
items.trade_off: 新增 host 端重复 layout 逻辑、metadata 搬运、picklability 与 input-pipeline CPU cost；config/model revision 漂移需失效缓存/重新验收。
items.failure: shape 可以合法但 token permutation/layout 错误；或未覆盖 rotary/mRoPE 同步，导致 silent divergence 或收益落空。
items.fallback: 不传 precomputed metadata，恢复 device-side 计算；等价 gate 或端到端 profile 不通过时关闭优化分支。
items.evidence_boundary: VeOmni PR #779, merge d13637a1c8266c4a6b6a14a07923392e91ccbf9a; A100 repository tests 18/18 sync gate and 26/26 Qwen logits, including rtol=0 atol=0 paired fallback comparison.
items.non_proof: No end-to-end step time, CPU cost, multi-node scaling, production tail or cross-family guarantee.

items.anchor: Gradient bucket、accumulation boundary 和 reduce-scatter timing 会影响 peak memory 与 overlap。不能只看 steady-state shard size。
items.placement: immediately after the exact anchor and before Stage 3
items.proposed_delta: HSDP 同时有 shard dimension 与 replicated dimension：每个 accumulation micro-step 的 local gradient 仍需 reduce-scatter 到 shard owner，但 replicated all-reduce 只需在 optimizer commit 前的最后 micro-step 完成。runtime 必须用 accumulation index、replica group 与 reduction convention 识别 final boundary，不能把两类 collective 一并跳过。
items.trade_off: 节省 replicated communication 的暴露时间但不省 model-state memory，并增加 final-boundary/replica membership 状态与数值等价验收。
items.failure: final micro-step、group 或 sum/mean convention 错误会让 replica gradient/update silent divergence。
items.fallback: 每个 micro-step 继续执行完整 reduce-scatter + replicated all-reduce；优化路径需先做 gradient/update equivalence 和 convergence check。
items.evidence_boundary: VeOmni PR #781, merge 4c42062b6bf68a68c8b009764eec0de929c7a3d3; Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, FSDP2/offload, EP=8, MBS=1, GBS=128 logs only.
items.non_proof: No disclosed hardware/node count, repeat statistics, variance or convergence-equivalent quality; do not adopt the small headline timing as a general speedup.
